perf.summary: Hoist invariant dp[mask*n+v] load and w[v*n] row base out of the inner u-loop, same as the cycle variant.
perf.currentCost: dp[mask*n+v] is reloaded n times though invariant; w[v*n+u] recomputes v*n each iteration.
perf.proposedChange: `long baseDp = dp[mask * n + v]; long* wRow = w + v * n;` before the loop; use `baseDp + wRow[u]` and `wRow[u] >= inf`.
perf.rationale: Shorter dependency chain and one fewer multiply per inner iteration in the dominant O(2^n * n^2) loop; deterministic invariant hoisting independent of optimizer.
perf.risk: None; the write target (mask|bit)*n+u differs from mask*n+v since bit u is newly set, so baseDp is not invalidated.
